description: "There is No Death" by Florence Marryat is a philosophical account written in the late 19th century that delves into the realm of Spiritualism and the existence of the afterlife. The book captures the author's personal experiences and observations while investigating spiritual phenomena, asserting that death is merely a transition rather than an end.
